value.rationale: The theorem gives natural exact invariants demanded by the centered modal-exchangeability framework: the dimension of all symmetry-admissible priors, the dimension visible to every root-modal query, their kernel, the sharp first loss at four worlds, and asymptotic growth of that loss.
